name: Amagiri Yune
source:
A gentle, kind girl who is good at looking after household chores. Speaks in polite form all the time and often asks people close to her to be her master. Yune is a transfer student from Japan. Very mature and calm, this character may seem like an ideal-Japanese-woman (Yamato Nadeshiko) type character, but don’t be fooled; Yune is actually a hardcore sadist, who loves watching the blushing faces of not only Tooru, but the other heroines as well.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dannychoo.com/en/post/26860/Amairo+Islenauts.html]Danny Choo's blog[/url] and [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2013/08/04/pure-love-story-on-a-fantasy-island-review-of-130726amairo-islenauts/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
